findings.title: Local vs CI test divergence on freeze SHA
findings.observation: On HEAD 48bbcffa, GitHub CI/CD run 32525882200 Tests=success and Playwright 32525882181=success, while local jest with CI-equivalent env (no Postgres) still has 11 failed suites / 16 failed tests; without full env 23 failed suites.
findings.rootCause: Multi-factor: (1) core.autocrlf=true CRLF checkout breaks LF-anchored architecture string gates; (2) no local Postgres service; (3) missing requireEnv vars without .env; (4) bare bash resolves to WSL stub for metricsBootstrap.
findings.repro: git config core.autocrlf true; checkout main@48bbcffa on Windows; set CI env vars; npx jest --ci; observe architecture gates fail while product symbols exist
findings.fixNeed: Normalize text gates to accept CRLF or force LF via .gitattributes; document required local env+Postgres parity script; pin bash path or skip metrics bootstrap off-Linux with explicit platform message (not silent greenwash).
findings.regressionTestNeed: CI job or unit helper that normalizes newlines before indexOf/toContain architecture checks; Windows smoke optional.

findings.title: db:consistency fails locally without DB
findings.observation: npm run db:consistency exit 3: Invalid prisma.$queryRawUnsafe() invocation; localhost:5432 not open.
findings.rootCause: env_gated — scanner requires live PostgreSQL; CI succeeds after migrate deploy against service container.
evidence: CI step Run DB orphan/consistency scanner=success
findings.fixNeed: No product fix required for scanner itself based on CI green; local/dev docs must require DB. Do not treat local red as product INVALID without CI contradiction.

findings.title: Root npm audit 3 high (deepmerge-ts via prisma)
findings.observation: npm audit --audit-level=high exit 1; deepmerge-ts <8.0.0 GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx through @prisma/config → prisma. Critical=0. Dashboard prod omit=dev high=0.
findings.rootCause: Transitive pin inside prisma 7.x line; force fix pulls prisma@6.12.0 breaking.
findings.fixNeed: Track prisma release that bumps deepmerge-ts>=8; document exception with expiry; do not force-downgrade prisma.
findings.regressionTestNeed: Keep critical blocking; consider policy decision if high must block release (Issue #73 security open).

findings.title: Architecture/runtime string gates brittle under CRLF (false local FAIL)
findings.observation: Suites fail with indexOf -1 / toContain missing LF substrings despite code presence: interactionDispatcherProduction, dashboardPermissionIntegrityArchitecture, leaveRejoinLifecycleGate, nitradoWhitelistIntentGate, nitradoTokenValidationLockGate, nitradoAdmBindingFenceGate, nitradoConfigLockConnectCleanupGate.
findings.rootCause: stale_gate_or_platform_drift — tests embed exact \n sequences; Windows CRLF working tree fails; Ubuntu CI LF passes (explains CI green).
evidence: finally+lock.release present with CRLF in tokenValidationCron.ts
findings.fixNeed: Normalize source text (replace \r\n→\n) inside gate helpers; optionally add .gitattributes text=auto eol=lf for src/tests.
findings.regressionTestNeed: Helper unit test with CRLF fixture; do not delete gates.

findings.title: PostgreSQL integration suites cannot run without service
findings.observation: economyTwoServerIsolationIntegration, nitradoValidationHealthIntegration, idempotencyMigrationRepair fail with Prisma/AggregateError connection errors when DATABASE_URL points at down Postgres.
findings.fixNeed: Provide docker-compose test DB profile for local parity; CI already covers.
findings.regressionTestNeed: None beyond existing CI integration path.

findings.title: metricsBootstrap tests fail when bash is WSL stub
findings.observation: tests/deploy/metricsBootstrap.test.ts spawnSync('bash') status=1; stdout indicates Windows Subsystem for Linux has no installed distributions. Git Bash executes deploy/ensure-metrics-token.sh with status 0.
findings.rootCause: env_platform — PATH bash ≠ Git bash on this host.
evidence: node spawnSync comparison WindowsApps vs Git bash
findings.fixNeed: Resolve bash via GIT_BASH / program files in test or document Linux-only; not a script logic failure proven on Git bash.

findings.title: Jest suites import config.ts requireEnv without jest setup env
findings.observation: Without ENCRYPTION_KEY (and other requireEnv), 12 module/command/ai suites fail at load: bankInterest, linkRewards, getAccountOrZero, economyStructuredLedger, economyLottery, consoleLinkingCommands, translatedPostImage*, botInfoConsistency, privilegedCommand*, nitradoModerationCommandSchema.
findings.rootCause: env_gated — no global jest setupFiles exporting CI secrets; CI workflow env injects them.
findings.fixNeed: Optional tests/setup-env.ts mirroring CI placeholders for local npm test ergonomics (must not weaken assertions).
findings.regressionTestNeed: Ensure setup only supplies non-secret test placeholders.

findings.title: Lint warnings and large UI chunk remain
findings.observation: lint:all exit 0 with 13 UI warnings; production build index chunk ~775kB gzip ~211kB.
findings.rootCause: pre-existing non-blocking quality gaps (also F-PRE-04 / F-S4-08).
findings.fixNeed: Bundle split / warning cleanup tracked under #73 open checkboxes.
findings.regressionTestNeed: Bundle budget gate if product requires.

findings.title: GitHub mandatory jobs success on freeze SHA (reconfirmed)
findings.observation: CI/CD 32525882200 all required jobs success; E2E 32525882181 Playwright Smoke success; skipped steps are conditional/non-mandatory (open-handle diagnose, browser cache miss install, failure report upload).
findings.fixNeed: None for GH green; still do not alone promote PRODUCTION READY while #73 Abschluss and F-S5-01/03 open.

notes: No suite in the residual 11 was classified as proven product functional bug solely from local evidence; CI green + CRLF/env explanation covers them. Residual product risk remains if LF CI gates are outdated relative to semantics (separate from CRLF) — not disproven beyond CI pass.
Do not mark architecture contracts VERIFIED from CI alone if gates only do string matching (Step4 posture retained).
